about:
Palmetto Shirt Company operates from Leesville, South Carolina, where it runs an e-commerce storefront selling officially licensed University of South Carolina apparel. The company's founding year, ownership structure, and founders are not publicly disclosed in the available sources.

The business focuses on retailing Gamecocks-branded t-shirts across multiple design collections, including the "Palmetto State Collection" featuring state-pride graphics such as the Palmetto Tradition Flag and "American Born – Carolina Raised" motifs. Products are priced between $19.99 and $28.99 per shirt. No manufacturing processes, facility details, headcount, or production volumes are described in the source material.

The primary customer base consists of University of South Carolina alumni, students, and fans seeking licensed game-day and everyday wear. The site also carries designs appealing to broader South Carolina pride purchasers. No industrial or B2B customer segments are identified in the input.

The company emphasizes its official licensing relationship with the University of South Carolina and its curated selection of Palmetto-themed artwork as its core appeal. No explicit founding mission or differentiation statement beyond the licensed product assortment is provided.
